data_source: CanadaBuys contract history, Public Services and Procurement Canada
definition: Non-competitive proxy equals procurement method Non-competitive, Advance Contract Award Notice, Advanced Contract Award Notice, or ACAN among original-award rows. Open, traditional, and selective tendering are coded competitive. Missing/unmapped procurement methods are excluded from denominators.
null_handling: Rows missing procurement method or award/start year are not coerced to competitive or non-competitive; they are excluded from yearly rates and counted in diagnostics.
